name: app-hand-held-health-care-score-phone-with-ghost-title-and-rings
title: Health Care Phone with Ghost Title and Rings
whatItIs: A pale blue cover with a hand holding a phone showing a 92% health score card, an analyse button and metric cards, with giant faint 'Health Care' lettering behind and concentric rings in the background.
whatItMeans: Soft blue tones and rings feel calm and clinical, and the hand keeps it human.
techniques: Ghost lettering cropped behind the phone
Concentric circles as a light background motif
Pale blue palette across UI and scene
Dark-skinned hand in strong contrast to pale UI
Blue pill call to action inside the UI

vocabulary.definition: Oversized faint text behind a subject.
Circles sharing a centre used as decoration.
A card showing an overall health score.
